propositions: A ticket with a live supersedes or duplicates link cannot be closed via rebar transition --class=superseded/duplicate because the plan-review close gate demands a certified attestation but the ticket is by construction unable to earn it (review blocks on findings that the work already exists).

The plan-review close gate function close_plan_review_gate_check lacks visibility to the close disposition parameter, so it cannot exempt link-backed administrative dispositions even though the completion verification gate already honors the same evidence.

The fix must thread close_class and tracker into close_plan_review_gate_check as keyword-only parameters with defaults to preserve caller compatibility, then exempt only when the class is in {duplicate, superseded} AND a live replacement link exists.

The only current workaround is rebar transition --force, which records no signed attestation and degrades the audit trail for evidence-backed dispositions, and causes ancestor epics to lose their completion signature.
